item.title: misc
item.description:
Outside of research, I spend most of my time on music: exploring local venues and bands and getting involved with whatever radio stations are around.

At the University of Maryland, I was part of the student run radio station, WMUC 90.5 where I hosted the show shut up and listen where I played experimental electronica and electronic and synt pop from around the world.

Take a listen to their current programing here: WMUC-FM College Park 90.5FM
